description: This file defines the RoutingResults class within the Slim framework, which encapsulates the result of routing an HTTP request, including route status, arguments, and related information.

classes.name: RoutingResults
classes.description: Encapsulates the results of routing an HTTP request, including status, route identifier, arguments, and dispatcher information.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the DispatcherInterface instance associated with this routing result.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for the request.

methods.name: getRouteStatus
methods.description: Returns the routing status (NOT_FOUND, FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED).

methods.name: getRouteIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the matched route, if any.

methods.name: getRouteArguments
methods.description: Returns the route arguments, optionally URL-decoded based on the parameter.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed HTTP methods for the route's URI, as provided by the dispatcher.
